subject: Marketplace private offer: structured discount and reseller uplift request
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.alvarez@nimbus-analytics.com
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private offer request + channel uplift need

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for taking this. Nimbus is ready to move to a private offer on AWS Marketplace for our upcoming pilot (Q4). We put together a short requirements file that outlines expected committed consumption (~$225k ARR equivalent for the first 12 months) and our procurement asks — attached (Nimbus_requirements.xlsx).

Key asks from procurement:
- A structured discount schedule on the private offer that increases with usage (we prefer 3 bands).
- Evidence the private offer can support reseller/reseller-uplift (we have a reseller partner who expects a 15% uplift on list).
- A single-invoice path to accommodate our consolidated billing team.

Timeline: Procurement needs a signed PO or DocuSign by 2027-09-15 to hit their internal quarter close.

Couple quick clarifying Qs for you:
1) Do you support explicit reseller margin pass-through in the private offer (i.e., separate line for partner uplift)?
2) We may ask for an early-adopter credit for months 1–3 if we hit a baseline consumption — is that something Redwood does for marketplace private offers?

I copied Tom (commercial lead) — happy to hop on a 30m call tomorrow if useful.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Kim
Head of Procurement | Nimbus Analytics
attachments: Nimbus_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request + channel uplift need

Sarah —

Appreciate the detail, and welcome — excited about the pilot. I reviewed the requirements and looped Ben (account exec) and Irene (deal ops) to capture the commercial/ops side. A few immediate notes:

- Yes, AWS private offers support line-item structure; we can model a reseller uplift as either a separate pass-through line or embed the uplift in the net price. We typically recommend a separate uplift line for clarity in invoicing.
- We can do a three-band structured discount. To align incentives, our preferred cadence is: Band A (0–$50k/m) = base price, Band B ($50–$150k/m) = 8% off list, Band C (> $150k/m) = 14% off list. These are starting points — we can adjust to match Nimbus's forecasts.
- Early-adopter credit for months 1–3: we can offer a usage credit equal to 10% of billed usage (applied as a credit memo) if the account hits the committed threshold in the first 90 days.

Operational asks from our side:
1) Can you share a 12-month forecast by band so ops can size the private offer SKU and capacity?
2) Confirm whether the reseller expects the 15% uplift on top of list (i.e., customer sees list, reseller gets +15%) or expects a 15% uplift against the Redwood net price. That changes how we represent the uplift line.

Irene — can you confirm if we can expose a separate "Partner Uplift" line in the PO for AWS private offers and if that has any tax/invoice implications?

If helpful, Ben can schedule a 30-minute pricing alignment call later today.

Best,
Priyom
Sr. Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_private_offer_template.pdf (pdf)

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request + channel uplift need

Priyom / team —

Thanks for the quick reply. A few clarifications from Nimbus:

- The reseller expects a 15% uplift on top of the published list so their margin is transparent to our procurement. In practice that means Nimbus would see the list price, Redwood would invoice net-of-uplift, and the reseller would invoice Nimbus the uplift amount. We need the uplift visible on the marketplace line-item so our finance team can reconcile.
- Forecast: attached is a simple monthly ramp forecast and our preferred 3-band thresholds (please see Nimbus_redlines_v1.xlsx). Our ramp has us hitting Band B by month 2 and Band C in month 6 under our best-case.
- Early-adopter credit: 10% works as long as it's recorded as a credit memo on the AWS invoice (not a separate off-invoice credit).

Two process items:
1) Can Redwood provide an example invoice or sample line-item layout showing a separate Partner Uplift line?
2) We need the DocuSign PO to reflect the uplift line and terminate any ambiguity for our procurement/legal teams.

Happy to take the call tomorrow afternoon if that helps; otherwise, Ben / Irene — can you send a sample invoice mock and a draft private offer config by EOD? We need to get internal sign-off first.

Tom
Tom Alvarez
Commercial Lead | Nimbus Analytics
attachments: Nimbus_redlines_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request + channel uplift need

Sarah / Tom —

Thanks for the forecast and redlines. Per the attachments and our internal ops check, here's a concise proposal we can push today:

Proposed private offer configuration (summary):
- SKU: NIM-REDWOOD-STD (metered on usage units)
- Structured discounts by band (monthly usage): Band A: 0–$50k = list price; Band B: $50k–$150k = 8% off list; Band C: >$150k = 14% off list.
- Partner Uplift: separate line item visible on the AWS invoice labeled "Partner Uplift (reseller)". Redwood will set the uplift at 15% of list and show the amount as a distinct line; Redwood invoices net of uplift to Nimbus and provides the uplift amount as a line for reconciliation.
- Early-adopter credit: 10% credit memo applied if the committed threshold is reached within the first 90 days.

Next steps and timeline:
1) Irene will send a sample invoice mock and the AWS private offer JSON config (for your procurement team to review) by EOD.
2) We will prepare a DocuSign PO that mirrors the private offer lines (including the Partner Uplift line) — target for sending to Nimbus by 2027-09-07.
3) Please confirm acceptance of the band thresholds and uplift mechanism; once you confirm we’ll get the PO out.

Operational notes: displaying the uplift as a separate line does not change Redwood's tax reporting, but your finance team should expect a separate invoice/reconciliation step with the reseller for uplift collection. If the reseller needs Redwood to collect and remit uplift, that will add complexity to billing and may require a separate reseller agreement.

Irene — flagged you to add any technical caveats.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: sample_invoice_mock.pdf (will be sent), private_offer_config.json (ops)
